title: Security ask contextualizer and response allocator for enterprise compliance requests
creator: Sofia Martinez
description: Problem: Enterprise customers submit security and compliance asks (vendor questionnaires, SOC2/ISO checklists, DPA exceptions, HIPAA scoping, GDPR data residency) through multiple channels (email, support forms, sales tickets). Current triage is manual, slow, and inconsistent across hosting modes (hosted, dedicated, private). We need a lightweight product-layer that: 1) automatically classifies and contextualizes incoming asks by regulation and technical scope, 2) enriches with account metadata (hosting mode, region, contract clauses, prior evidence bundles), 3) suggests a prioritized response lane (self-serve doc, engineering runbook, legal review), and 4) surfaces expected SLAs and required evidence to reduce back-and-forth.
goals: Reduce time-to-first-response for high-priority compliance asks to < 48 hours
Reduce engineering handoffs for SOC2/GDPR/DPA clarifications by 30%
Provide account-aware suggested responses with prefilled evidence links (audit artifacts, Confluence answers)
Enable routing rules to Legal/InfoSec/Engineering with clear required inputs and estimated SLA
Ship a minimal console UI + API that integrates with existing support and vendor-questionnaire intake flows
scope: Classifier service that tags incoming asks by category (SOC2, GDPR, HIPAA, DPA, vendor-questionnaire) and by technical domain (data residency, encryption, access controls, log retention)
Enrichment pipeline to attach account metadata: hosting mode, contract tier, compliance add-ons, previously-uploaded evidence
Priority allocator that maps severity + customer tier to a response lane and suggested SLA
Response templates and evidence bundler generator for common question patterns
Console question detail page UI with suggested lane, prefilled recommended response, and one-click evidence attach
API/webhook to integrate classifier results into support ticketing and Linear issues
non_goals: Implementing full automated Q&A that generates legal language (Legal approval still required)
Replacing dedicated Legal/InfoSec reviewers for escalations
Major infra changes to serving runtime — this is product workflow and routing work
acceptance_criteria: Classifier reaches >= 88% precision on a held-out set of labeled historical tickets for regulation category
UI displays account-aware recommended lane and evidence links for 95% of sample tickets in pilot accounts
Routing rules produce Linear issues with correct tags and assigned teams in 90% of pilot runs
SLA estimator computes recommended SLA and visible ETA in the ticket detail page
Pilot with 5 enterprise customers reduces average time-to-first-meaningful-response by >= 30% vs baseline
approach_and_decisions: Start with a rules + ML hybrid classifier: regex and metadata rules for high-precision categories (e.g., 'DPA', 'SCCs', 'HIPAA'), and an LLM-powered classifier for fuzzier vendor-questionnaire language
Enrichment will read from existing account metadata services; do not duplicate PII or contractual text in product tables — link to evidence instead
Prioritize hosting-mode heuristics early: requests mentioning 'on-prem', 'VPC', or specific regions should escalate to Private/Dedicated lanes
Response templates are curated by Legal/Trust; product ships templates as suggestions only and flags required legal approval steps
Initial rollout will be read-only classifier + suggested labels for internal agents; writeback/routing enabled after 2-week pilot
integrations_and_webhooks: Support system: webhook to create a ticket enriched with classifier tags
Linear: automated issue creation with project mapping and labels
Evidence storage: link into existing evidence-bundles S3 path
risks_and_mitigation: False positives in classifier -> lock to 'suggested' mode for first 2 weeks and provide quick undo in UI
Leaking contractual language -> do not store contract text; surface links only; require access control on evidence bundles
Over-automation of legal responses -> require explicit legal approval step for any template that modifies policy wording
Cross-account data residency escalations -> add explicit reviewer step for Private-hosted accounts and SRE on-call notification
metrics: Mean time to first meaningful response (target < 48h)
% reduction in engineering-required handoffs for compliance asks
% of tickets with prefilled evidence chosen by agents
Pilot NPS from support/SEs on usefulness of suggestions
